name: (03) Thaumaturgy (Path of Blood) — 2 Intermediate — Blood of Potency

system.description:
With a murmured word the thaumaturge distills the blood within their own body, concentrating its curse until it runs with the potency of far older Cainites.

Spend a moment murmuring, then expend Mental Traits to gain a "virtual generation": each generation you artificially lower costs two Mental Traits, to a maximum of six Traits for three generations. This raises your maximum Blood Traits and lets your Dominate affect more powerful Cainites. The effect lasts the scene or one hour, whichever ends first, and may be used only once per night; when it wears off any blood above your normal limit dilutes away instantly. Your true generation, not your virtual one, is used for diablerie and for the generation of any childer you Embrace. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
